name: Supervisor Raelen
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Supervisor Raelen keeps timber moving toward Stormwind. She manages the laborers, tracks daily quotas, and oversees the lumber supply.

sections.title: Keeping the Camp on Schedule
sections.body: Supervisor Raelen directs the woodcutters at Eastvale Logging Camp, near Marshal Patterson and the camp’s wagons. The camp stands on the edge of eastern Elwynn, near the Redridge Mountains, where the work brings its share of trouble. Raelen coordinates the crews and keeps them focused on their quotas despite hazards in the surrounding woods. She sees that gathered timber is processed, bundled, and sent on toward Stormwind.

faq.answer: Supervisor Raelen oversees the logging crews at Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. She manages their work and keeps their timber quotas on schedule.

faq.q: Where can I find Supervisor Raelen?
faq.answer: Supervisor Raelen is in the center of Eastvale Logging Camp, near the loaded wood wagons and Marshal Patterson.

faq.q: Why does Supervisor Raelen need help from adventurers?
faq.answer: Timber gathering near the forest’s edge can be dangerous. When wildlife or other disruptions trouble the workers, cut lumber bundles may be abandoned or scattered among the trees.

faq.q: What role does the Eastvale Logging Camp play in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp is the main logging operation in eastern Elwynn Forest. Its lumber supports rebuilding and maintenance in Stormwind and nearby settlements.

angles.text: Stormwind needs timber for its defenses and construction, so Raelen’s lumber quotas matter to the kingdom’s war effort.
